intent: Refine generic multigym/cable equipment details and provide a clear9m numbered green CrossFit lane in the300m² demo. Preserve model envelopes, low-power rendering, saved projects and automatic2D recovery.

findings.title: Two-level demo track runs into the stairwell
findings.why_it_matters: The existing Demo2niveluri composes demoBuildingSpace from demoSpace, then places its stairwell in the back-right corner. Moving the inherited ground-floor functional lane to that same corner makes its last3m pass through the staircase, so the numbered lane is not usable end-to-end in that demo.
evidence: src/lib/gym-space.ts:202 -- { id: 'functional', name: 'Pistă CrossFit · 9 m', colour: '#3f7653', x: 10.3, y: 12.8, w: 9.3, d: 1.6 },
src/lib/gym-building.ts:47 -- ground.stairwell = { x: 16.6, y: 9.8, w: 3, d: 4.8, opening: false };

Reproduction on reviewed snapshot: polygonsOverlap(boxPolygon(demoBuildingSpace().areas.find(a=>a.id==='functional')),boxPolygon(demoBuildingSpace().stairwell)) returns true. Lane ends at x19.6,z14.4, while stairs occupy x16.6..19.6,z9.8..14.6.
findings.suggested_fix: Override the inherited ground functional area in demoBuildingSpace so it stays outside its stairwell; preserve the new9m lane in the single-floor demo and the existing upper10m lane. Add an assertion that demo building functional areas do not overlap their stairwell.
